name: Kimi o Shitteru, Hazu Datta.
original_name: 君をしってる、はずだった。
source:
April, with its pleasant spring breeze.

Now a sophomore in college, you’ve made up your mind to find your first girlfriend.

Amidst this, at a welcome party for new students in your haiku seminar, you meet a girl who tells you, “I know your secret.”

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4825800/I_thought_I_knew_you/]Steam[/url]]
